'''Clyngunn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[ZeHethbra]]. Originally a star [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]], Clyngunn grew weary of the sporting life and went in search of excitement. His quest led him to a career in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], in which he also excelled. After the collapse of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Clyngunn joined [[Talon Karrde]] and the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] in fighting against [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].

==Biography==
===Fame and boredom===
[[File:Clyngunn Gamer.png|thumb|left|150px|Clyngunn]]
A [[ZeHethbra]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]], Clyngunn represented his [[Species/Legends|species]] in the famed [[Stratis Games]] on [[Hallrin IV]] in the [[Multi-Sentient Unarmed Combat Rounds]]. Clyngunn garnered the highest honors in his class, setting the record for most sentients bested in one round. He eventually left the field of sports and became jaded; acting on a friend's suggestion that he use his funds to buy a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and search for meaning, Clyngunn purchased a [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] and toured a variety of resort planets. However, doing so did not alleviate his boredom.<ref name="TTS" />

===The smuggler's life===
Traveling to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], Clyngunn met the aging [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Billey]], himself something of a legend amongst his fellows. It was through Billey that Clyngunn finally found something that offered the thrills and excitement the ZeHethbra was looking for: the life of a smuggler. Trading his yacht for a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], Clyngunn set about customizing it for speed, cargo concealment, and combat readiness. He smuggled [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and [[Blaster/Legends|guns]]. At one point, he was stopped by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] forces, but was released due to his sports fame.<ref name="TTS" />

Clyngunn didn't really like most other smugglers, as shown in his interview with the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] regarding [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]]. However, events in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were happening that would make it difficult for a lone smuggler to earn his keep.

===New era, new alliances===
[[File:Clygunn_TLC.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Clyngunn meeting with Talon Karrde]]
With the collapse of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the subsequent chaos surrounding the ex-Imperial [[General/Legends|generals]] and [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] fighting over the remnants, as well as penalties for smuggling growing stiffer, it became difficult for a smuggler to make a living. Clyngunn joined [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smugglers' Alliance]] to fight against [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], obtaining Karrde's personal guarantee that he would not be expected to change his attitude towards working on his own.

==Personality and traits==
Clyngunn preferred to work alone; while he claimed that doing so reduced his overhead, in reality he did not trust other smugglers. He possessed a short temper, and was capable of inflicting serious damage on assailants. A male ZeHethbra, Clyngunn had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] with a central white stripe. He wore blue [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] and [[Clothing/Legends|tunics]], along with a pair of black [[Bantha hide/Legends|bantha hide]] slacks.<ref name="TTS" />
